web_fixture.title: Collector defaults - Yarnbrook telemetry
web_fixture.snippet: The Yarnbrook collector waits 26 seconds for a reading before it gives up on the device.
web_fixture.content:
# Collector defaults

Yarnbrook telemetry, reviewed 2026-05-12.

| setting | default |
| --- | --- |
| read_timeout_seconds | 26 |
| flush_interval_seconds | 15 |
| max_points_per_batch | 4000 |

The collector opens a connection to each device and waits read_timeout_seconds
for a reading; a device that stays silent for that long is marked unreachable
and picked up on the next pass. flush_interval_seconds is how often the
collector hands what it has to the ingest API.

web_fixture.title: Field kit plan - Yarnbrook
web_fixture.snippet: The field kit plan reads through a serial link and gives up after 45 seconds.
web_fixture.content:
# Field kit plan

Yarnbrook, plans.

On the field kit plan the collector talks to devices over a serial link and
gives up after 45 seconds. The field kit is a separate build of the collector
and its timings do not apply to the standard collector.

turns.prompt: Nobody has tuned our Yarnbrook collector. How long does it wait for a reading from a device before it gives up? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
